## What changed
I've updated the Context Engine to include AI-driven automation features, adding a waitlist endpoint to manage user emails. This change aims to drive innovation in the development space. I've also modified the Gemini API call to include the API key in the headers. 
The code now handles legacy/summary access for OCR text and includes email validation for the waitlist.

## Why
The problem this solves is the need for a more efficient and automated development process. By integrating AI-driven automation, we can enhance productivity and transform the way we work. The waitlist endpoint addresses the requirement to manage user interest in our product.

## How
I've taken a modular approach, updating the `generator.py` file to modify the Gemini API call and adding a new endpoint to the `routes.py` file for waitlist management. The `payload.py` file now includes joined OCR text for legacy access. Key functions changed include `_gemini_text_call` and `build_payload`. 

## Testing
I've tested the waitlist endpoint using a sample email address, verifying that it's appended to the waitlist file correctly. I've also validated the email format using a regular expression to ensure only valid emails are accepted. Automated tests for the Gemini API call were updated to reflect the changes in the API key handling.

## Notes for reviewer
Please pay special attention to the email validation in the waitlist endpoint, as it's crucial for preventing invalid emails from being added to the waitlist. I've used a regular expression to match the email format, but you may want to review it for any potential edge cases. Are there any concerns about the approach taken to integrate AI-driven automation in this update?
